mechanism_narrative: A positive 3-month change in CPIAUCSL (indicating rising inflation) predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL 3-month change > 0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is < 0.03.
